213:     """Binary line reader over an unbuffered file: counts every physical byte and hashes consumed lines."""
214: 
215:     def __init__(self, path, *, chunk_size=DEFAULT_CHUNK, max_physical_bytes=None):
216:         if chunk_size < 1:
217:             raise HarnessError("chunk_size must be positive")
218:         self.path = Path(path)
219:         self.chunk_size = int(chunk_size)
220:         self.max_physical_bytes = max_physical_bytes
221:         self.size_bytes = self.path.stat().st_size
222:         self.physical_bytes_read = 0
223:         self.read_calls = 0
224:         self.consumed_bytes = 0
225:         self.rows = 0
226:         self.reached_eof = False
227:         self._buffer = b""
228:         self._digest = hashlib.sha256()
229:         _IN_HARNESS_READ.active = True
230:         try:
231:             self._handle = builtins.open(self.path, "rb", buffering=0)
232:         finally:
233:             _IN_HARNESS_READ.active = False
234: 
235:     def next_line(self):
236:         while True:
237:             index = self._buffer.find(b"\n")
238:             if index >= 0:
239:                 line, self._buffer = self._buffer[:index + 1], self._buffer[index + 1:]
240:                 return self._consume(line)
241:             if len(self._buffer) > MAX_LINE_BYTES:
242:                 raise ReadBoundaryError(f"{self.path.name}: line exceeds {MAX_LINE_BYTES} bytes")
243:             if self.reached_eof:
244:                 if self._buffer:
245:                     line, self._buffer = self._buffer, b""
246:                     return self._consume(line)
247:                 return None
248:             if self.max_physical_bytes is not None and self.physical_bytes_read >= self.max_physical_bytes:
249:                 raise ReadBoundaryError(f"{self.path.name}: physical read cap {self.max_physical_bytes} reached")
250:             chunk = self._handle.read(self.chunk_size)
251:             self.read_calls += 1
252:             if not chunk:
253:                 self.reached_eof = True
254:             self.physical_bytes_read += len(chunk)
255:             self._buffer += chunk
256: 
257:     def _consume(self, line: bytes) -> bytes:
258:         if len(line) > MAX_LINE_BYTES:
259:             raise ReadBoundaryError(f"{self.path.name}: line exceeds {MAX_LINE_BYTES} bytes")
260:         self._digest.update(line)
261:         self.consumed_bytes += len(line)
262:         self.rows += 1
263:         return line
264: 
265:     def close(self):
266:         self._handle.close()
267: 
268:     def record(self, *, strict_prefix=True) -> dict:
269:         overread = self.physical_bytes_read - self.consumed_bytes
270:         if overread < 0 or overread >= self.chunk_size:
271:             raise ReadBoundaryError(f"{self.path.name}: overread {overread} outside [0,{self.chunk_size})")
272:         if strict_prefix and (self.reached_eof or self.physical_bytes_read >= self.size_bytes):
273:             raise ReadBoundaryError(f"{self.path.name}: bounded access not proven (read reached end of file)")
274:         return dict(path=str(self.path), size_bytes=self.size_bytes, chunk_size=self.chunk_size,
275:                     physical_bytes_read=self.physical_bytes_read, consumed_bytes=self.consumed_bytes,
276:                     overread_bytes=overread, read_calls=self.read_calls, lines_consumed=self.rows,
277:                     reached_eof=self.reached_eof, consumed_prefix_sha256=self._digest.hexdigest())
